instruction: Query the OQMD database for Zn-O binary polymorphs (element_set=Zn,O AND ntypes=2) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by delta_e ascending in Python. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata), the most stable entry (lowest delta_e: entry_id/name/delta_e/stability/spacegroup), and the least stable entry (highest delta_e among the returned results: entry_id/name/delta_e/stability/spacegroup) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_16.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
